methods.title: Daily source-reported active users
methods.description: Filter calendar dates and exact workspace IDs, then aggregate valid active_users records by day. Workspace identifiers remain strings.
methods.formula: For each date: sum(active_users), or sum(active_users) / number of valid records.
methods.missing: Exclude filtered records, missing or invalid ISO dates, and blank, nonfinite, negative or noninteger active_users values. Missing workspace IDs remain included when all workspaces are selected. Missing dates are not filled with zero.
methods.assumptions: Source-reported daily aggregates, not independently verified distinct users. No deduplication. Summing workspace records may double-count people; averaging records is not overall DAU. Workspace coverage can change by date. Dates are source calendar dates rendered in UTC. Future-dated rows are retained and flagged; refresh time and completeness are unknown. signups is not used.
